# Star Cleaning SC

> Veteran-owned house cleaning company serving Charleston, SC and the Lowcountry (Summerville, North Charleston, Mount Pleasant, Goose Creek, Ladson, James Island, Daniel Island, Johns Island). 18 years in business, background-checked staff, 100% satisfaction guarantee, eco-friendly and pet-safe products. Call or text (843) 297-9935.

## Services
- [Residential Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/residential-cleaning): Recurring weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly house cleaning.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/deep-cleaning): One-time, top-to-bottom intensive cleaning.
- [Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning): Cleaning for empty homes during a move.
- [Vacation Rental / Airbnb Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/vacation-rental-airbnb-cleaning): Fast turnovers for short-term rental hosts.
- [Commercial & Office Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/commercial-office-cleaning): Cleaning for offices, retail, and small businesses.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://www.starcleaningsc.com/services/post-construction-cleaning): Dust and debris removal after renovation or new builds.
